query:
INSERT INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, role, notes) 
SELECT p.id, m.id, 'secondaire', 'Lien Mambe - Source: Wikipedia ES - Molécules de torréfaction'
FROM plants p, molecules m 
WHERE p.latin_name = 'Erythroxylum coca var. ipadu' 
AND m.name IN ('Cinnamoylcocaïne', 'Ecgonine', '2-Méthylpyrazine', '2,5-Diméthylpyrazine', 'Furfural')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE notes = VALUES(notes);
